full_judgment: 2. Facts relevant for the purpose of disposal of this petition, in brief, are that the pre-emption filed a Miscellaneous Case No. 34 of 2005 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Mohadebpur, Naogaon under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act for getting 1.41 acres of land by way of pre-emption. His case, in short, is that by a registered deed of sale dated 28.06.2005, seller opposite party Nos. 2 and 3 transferred the case land to the preemptee. The `Ka' schedule jute belonged to Shashi Chandra and others. The pre-emptor is a co-sharer by inheritance as well as by purchase. The recorded tenant Shashi Chandra died leaving behind three sons, Sudhir, Susil and Sunil. After dial, Sunil transferred .21½ acre out of 2.16 acres of land from the case holding by a registered deed of sale dated 23.08.1982 to the pre-emptor and also to the co-sharer opposite party Nos. 28-29 and one Nikhil. His further case was that co-sharers, Kazal and Bijan transferred 24 acre of land out of the case holding by a registered deed of sale dated 17.06.1996 to the pre-emptor. Pre-emptee No. 1 is not a co-sharer and seller opposite Nos. 2 and 3 being co-sharers transferred 1.41 acres of land by a registered deed of sale dated 28.06.2005 without serving any notice upon preemptor. On 28.06.2005, the pre-emptor came to know about the transfer and filed the miscellaneous case for preemption.
